content.short: CARV builds credentials and data infrastructure for gaming.
content.description: CARV enables gamers to translate achievements into SBTs (soulbound tokens) to preserve data sovereignty. Users can review their gaming footprints, mint these achievements into SBTs, and unlock SBT-gated benefits across games while keeping their data private. There is a private SBT-based game-sharing community that supports more genuine game discovery. SBTs showcasing players' memories connect via a middleware to other Web2 or Web3 social spaces, enabling private credential-based socializing. CARV provides unified scores, leaderboards, insights, and recommendations with privacy preservation. As of March 2023, it has reached over half a million users and serves as a hub for community understanding and growth, while on-chain visibility and private profile-level data help games understand engagement and target the right audience.
